possible_explanations.statement: The price spike may have been associated with a short-lived supply/demand imbalance around 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000); the dispatch TOTALDEMAND series shows an increase in the half hour ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000) (see dispatch TOTALDEMAND values ev0417..ev0435).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check unit-level dispatch SCADA and participant bid/offers for the interval ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000) to see whether available supply or offers changed for that specific five-minute interval.

possible_explanations.statement: The price spike might be related to a change in net interchange around 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000), since net interconnector flow at the peak interval is recorded as 63.84 MW (net export) (ev0436).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect higher-resolution interconnector dispatch/SCADA and any constraint notices covering the interval ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000).

possible_explanations.statement: The spike could have been an isolated high-priced bid/offer for a single dispatch interval ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review participant bid/offer submissions and dispatch instructions for the interval ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000).

uncertainties: No region-specific AEMO market notice for TAS1 in the 2026-08-06 02:00–04:00 UTC window was returned by the public-evidence search; procedures were returned but no market notice held for this region/window.

Unit-level dispatch behavior, participant bids/offers, and high-resolution interconnector or constraint notices were not inspected; these would reduce uncertainty about the immediate cause of the spike.
